headline: Peru National Elections Board Fixes Gubernatorial Runoffs for 15 Regions
summary: Peru's National Elections Board published a decree setting December 6 for runoff elections across 15 regions where no ticket secured 30% of first-round votes. The runoffs will determine regional governor leadership.
why: Peru's regional governments control local infrastructure spending, mining permit consultations, and public works concessions.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Regional elections resolve local administrative uncertainty for regional infrastructure spending.
